pictures.name: CGU1-Tepeyac-Dawn
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A rocky desert hill, Tepeyac, near the lake and the town of Tenochtitlan-Mexico in December 1531, before dawn: prickly pear cactus, mesquite, frost on the stones. In the middle, Juan Diego, a slender Indigenous Mexican man of about fifty with straight black hair and a gentle weathered face, in a white cotton tunic and a rough cream agave-fiber cloak (tilma) knotted at one shoulder, walks alone up the path, wrapped against the cold. The sky deep blue with the first faint gold at the horizon, distant volcano silhouettes. Humility, quiet faithfulness. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CGU2-Lady-Appears
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The top of the rocky hill of Tepeyac at dawn. In the middle, the Virgin Mary as Our Lady of Guadalupe: a young woman with a gentle brown Indigenous face, hands joined in prayer, in a rose-pink robe with gold flowers and a blue-green mantle scattered with gold stars, surrounded by golden rays, stands on the rocks, radiant, the stones around her shining like jewels and the cactus glowing gold. Before her, Juan Diego, a slender Indigenous Mexican man of about fifty with straight black hair and a gentle weathered face, in a white cotton tunic and a rough cream agave-fiber cloak (tilma) knotted at one shoulder, kneels in wonder, one hand on his heart, birds rising around them. Gold dawn light, deep blue sky. Tenderness, wonder, beauty. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CGU3-Bishop-Doubts
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A plain reception room in the bishop’s house in Mexico City, 1531: whitewashed walls, a dark wooden table, a crucifix. Bishop Juan de Zumárraga, an older Spanish Franciscan with a grey beard, in a brown habit, a purple skullcap and a pectoral cross, sits listening politely but doubtfully, one hand raised as if asking for proof. Before him, in the middle, Juan Diego, a slender Indigenous Mexican man of about fifty with straight black hair and a gentle weathered face, in a white cotton tunic and a rough cream agave-fiber cloak (tilma) knotted at one shoulder, stands with his hat in his hands, earnest and humble. A Spanish secretary watches skeptically from the side. Gold window light, deep blue shadows. Being overlooked. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CGU4-Am-I-Not-Here
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A side path around the hill of Tepeyac at dawn. Juan Diego, a slender Indigenous Mexican man of about fifty with straight black hair and a gentle weathered face, in a white cotton tunic and a rough cream agave-fiber cloak (tilma) knotted at one shoulder, hurrying with his head down, stops as the Virgin Mary as Our Lady of Guadalupe: a young woman with a gentle brown Indigenous face, hands joined in prayer, in a rose-pink robe with gold flowers and a blue-green mantle scattered with gold stars, surrounded by golden rays, comes down the hillside to meet him, her hands open toward him, her face full of motherly tenderness. In the background on the hilltop, bushes of red and pink roses bloom among frosty rocks. The two figures in the middle. Gold light, deep blue shadows. Comfort, motherly love. pictures.name: CGU5-Tilma-Opens
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The bishop’s room in Mexico City, 1531. In the middle, Juan Diego, a slender Indigenous Mexican man of about fifty with straight black hair and a gentle weathered face, in a white cotton tunic and a rough cream agave-fiber cloak (tilma) knotted at one shoulder, stands opening his rough cream tilma; a cascade of red and pink roses tumbles to the floor, and on the cloth glows the image of Our Lady of Guadalupe in rose and blue-green with gold stars and rays. Bishop Juan de Zumárraga, an older Spanish Franciscan with a grey beard, in a brown habit, a purple skullcap and a pectoral cross, has fallen to his knees before the cloak, astonished; the secretary drops his pen. Warm gold light pouring from the image, deep blue shadows. Awe, the lowly lifted up. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CGU6-Today-Basilica
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The modern Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe in Mexico City, painted in the same sacred oil style: a vast crowd of pilgrims of every age, families, grandmothers, young couples, many carrying red roses, gather in the square at dawn on December 12, some walking on their knees. Above, inside the great open doors, the framed image of Our Lady of Guadalupe glows. Warm gold light, deep blue morning sky. The pilgrims in the middle. Devotion, joy, the lowly honored. No text, no letters, no logos.
